answers.core:
Can't be an addon, since it affects the low-level RD API.
This has no impact on higher level rendering or visuals at the moment.
answers.workaround: Not in a few lines - it can be worked around with some relatively complex additional calculation: [e.g. this chapter from GPU Gems](https://developer.nvidia.com/gpugems/gpugems2/part-v-image-oriented-computing/chapter-42-conservative-rasterization) but most modern Desktop GPU's have hardware support for it, which greatly simplifies implementation.

title: Add Conservative Rasterization option to RenderingDevice
